## Type

## Skill checklist (for new skills)
- [ ] `marketplace.json` entry has a unique kebab-case `name`, a clear `description`, a valid `source`, and a `category`.
- [ ] The source resolves (repo public; `path`/`ref` correct for `git-subdir`).
- [ ] `SKILL.md` has valid frontmatter (name + trigger-rich description).
- [ ] I tested the skill in at least one agent.
- [ ] No secrets, no malicious/deceptive content, no covert tool/URL calls.

## Security note
By submitting, you confirm the skill contains no hidden instructions to exfiltrate data, bypass safety, or call tools/URLs covertly. The maintainer reviews every submission before listing.
